text: Step 01/06 - Start config and reproducible seed. Trigger: New game setup. Action: Choose map, player count, initial money, event interval, random seed. Result: Deterministic start and goals.
Step 02/06 - BeforeRoll action cards. Trigger: Turn start. Action: Pick 0-1 cards and confirm. Result: Pre-roll economy or ownership effects.
Step 03/06 - Roll, move, and event triggers. Trigger: After movement. Action: Resolve tile event first, then global event. Result: Money changes and explanations logged.
Step 04/06 - City build with multipliers. Trigger: Land on owned city. Action: Build or upgrade. Result: Building events with AppliedMultipliers breakdown.
Step 05/06 - Combat and return to loop. Trigger: Tile event starts combat. Action: Enter combat and return. Result: Combat outcome recorded and turn continues.
Step 06/06 - Win or lose and settlement. Trigger: End condition met. Action: Show result screen. Result: game.ended reason, winner, stats, next-step options.
Knowledge base 1/2 - Rounds and events. RoundNumber drives global events; order: Tile -> Global.
Knowledge base 2/2 - Source of truth and fallback. UI consumes Contracts and explanations; missing keys fall back to raw text.
